clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's own trick for a magnesium deficiency, which he says can drive up blood pressure: an Epsom salt bath.

Epsom salt isn't table salt, it's magnesium. A couple of cups in a warm bath at night, and he says the body absorbs the magnesium straight through the skin while you soak.

He's quick to say he has no stake in any brand of it: no sale, no commission, just something he personally uses before bed.

Comment HEALTH and we'll send you the one he keeps in his own house.
